column1: # site in the repo whose count is not a plain non-negative integer literal.
# The scanner lists them; this ledger records the human verdict so `--check`
# stays green on judged-safe sites and fails only on a NEW (untriaged) one.
#   STATUS = SAFE (proven not to go negative/NaN/fractional/≥2^32) | BUG (open)
# A count is SAFE when it is provably a non-negative integer < 2^32:
#   • `<arr>.length`         — always a nonneg int, capped well below 2^32
# A raw `end - start` / user-driven count with no such floor would be a BUG
# (clamp it, or use Array.from({length}) which clamps for you).
